Patch.FmodFixHelp: Fixes a sound system crash; some sounds may be missing (Dasaav).
Patch.NoFacegenHelp: Turns face generation off, stops stretched faces on shadPS4 (Kyo).

Patch.DebugCameraHelp: Free camera: hold [cross] and press [l3] to switch modes (Lance McDonald).
Patch.DebugDashHelp: [debug_fly] fly, [debug_up]/[debug_down] up/down, hold [debug_noclip] to go through walls; [debug_toggle] turns the debug tools on and off during play (stagvant).
Patch.EnemyControlHelp: [r3] controls the locked-on enemy, [l3] goes back (stagvant).
Fps60.Intro: The game runs everything in fixed steps of 1/30 s. Hunters' Accord switches it to the 60 FPS mode its developers left in the game and gives every system the real length of each frame, so nothing runs too fast or in slow motion.
Fps60.Benefit1: Real-time speed from 30 to 60 FPS: physics, cloth, corpses and the camera don't slow down when the frame rate drops.
Fps60.Benefit2: The parry window stays as in the original game (0.33 s).
Fps60.Benefit3: The camera's smoothing uses the game's own values, recalculated for each frame.
Fps60.Benefit4: Lava, regeneration, transfusions and rapid fire (Gatling, flamethrowers, breaths) hit as often as at 30 FPS.
Fps60.Benefit5: Movement in the air and against walls behaves as in the original game.
Fps60.Benefit6: Co-op: every player sends their character's state 6 times a second, at 30 or at 60 FPS.
Fps60.Benefit7: Timeouts and timers in seconds keep their length; motion blur at camera cuts no longer trips the game at 60 FPS.
Fps60.Benefit8: Built into the mod: no patch file to download, every change checks the game's bytes first. Co-op is tested at 30 and 60 FPS, in every mix.
Fps60.Limit1: Below 30 FPS the game slows down, as on the PS4.
Fps60.Limit2: Incompatible with No VSync and the Performance Patch.
Fps60.Limit3: Keep the emulator's VBlank at 60 Hz.
Fps60.Credits: Built on research of the game's frame timing; thanks to Lance McDonald and Kyo, whose 60 FPS patches showed the way.
Fps60.BenefitPartnerSpeed: Co-op: your partner's walk, run and sprint match their real speed.
Fps60.BenefitDodge: Dodging reads the stick as at 30 FPS: a step right after letting go of the stick stays a step.

GameText.PingOverPlayersHelp: Shows the network ping to each other player after their name over their character.
GameText.ConnectionModeHelp: Direct: lower ping. Relays: through Steam's servers, your IP stays hidden. If either player picks Relays, both use them.
GameText.News: You are playing Bloodborne with the Hunters' Accord mod by HappyEntity. Online play runs on a server emulated by the mod, not on the official servers. Seamless co-op is here: the host rings the Bell of the Shared Hunt, others answer with the Resonance of the Shared Hunt, and you hunt together through deaths, lamps, bosses and the Hunter's Dream. Ring the Parting of the Shared Hunt to go back to your own world.
GameText.CoopHostInfo: Open a seamless co-op session for other hunters.
GameText.CoopHostCaption:
A bell heard only by hunters of this age. Ring it to open your world to others, who may join the hunt and stay at your side through the whole night.

Its tone answers the Bell of the Shared Hunt. Ring it to step into another hunter's world and hunt at their side until your paths part.

Hunters' Accord co-op item. It is never used up.
